pages.title: Northfold, brand and digital design
pages.description: Northfold is a small studio designing brand identities and the websites that carry them.

sections.heading: Identities with a voice, and websites that move like them.
sections.intro: We are a small studio. We design the brand and build the site together, so the type, the motion and the words all come from one idea.

sections.label: Our approach
sections.text: Most brand work stops at the logo and hands the website to someone else. We keep both on the same table. The typeface decides how a page scrolls, the colour decides what moves, and every animation has to explain something or it goes.

sections.heading: Selected work
sections.intro: Examples of the kind of project we take on. Real case studies will replace these.

items.title: Tidewater Ferries
items.summary: A timetable you can read at a glance on a windy pier, and a wordmark cut from the shapes of harbour signage.

items.title: Loam & Ash
items.summary: An identity built from glaze tests, with a shop where each piece turns slowly as you scroll.

items.title: Field Notes Radio
items.summary: A moving logo that follows the live audio level, and a schedule that reads like a printed listing.

sections.heading: Have a brand that should move?
sections.text: Tell us what you are making and where it needs to go. We reply to every message ourselves.

pages.title: What Northfold does
pages.description: Brand identity, motion and websites, designed and built by one small team.

sections.heading: One team for the brand and the site.
paragraphs: We work with organisations that have something to show: a product, a place, a body of work. We start with what makes them different and design outward from there.
Because the same people design the identity and build the website, nothing gets lost in a handover. The decisions made in the brand carry straight into the pages.

aside.heading: Who we work with
aside.text: Cultural organisations, makers and product teams who care how their work is presented.

sections.heading: Services
sections.intro: Most projects combine two or three of these.

items.name: Brand identity
items.summary: Name, wordmark, type, colour and the rules that hold them together.

items.name: Motion identity
items.summary: How the brand moves: logo animation, transitions and the timing behind them.

items.name: Websites
items.summary: Designed and built in house, with motion that respects the people who prefer less of it.

items.name: Art direction
items.summary: Photography and illustration briefs that keep everything the brand makes recognisable.

sections.heading: How a project runs
sections.intro: Every project follows the same four steps, at a pace set together at the start.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: We read everything you have, talk to the people who use it, and agree what the work has to change.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: We design two or three directions at full size, with type and motion, so you can judge them as they will be seen.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: The chosen direction becomes the identity system and the website, built and reviewed in stages.

steps.title: Hand over
steps.text: You get the files, the guidelines and a walk-through, so your team can keep it going.

sections.heading: Start with a conversation.
sections.text: Send a few lines about the project. We will come back with questions, not a sales pitch.

sections.heading: Start a project
sections.intro: Tell us what you are making, who it is for and when it needs to be ready.

items.q: Do you only take full brand and website projects?
items.a: No. Some projects are a website for an existing identity, or a motion system for a brand that already exists.
